task_description: The agents need to collaboratively develop a feature for a project management software, which involves writing code based on specified requirements, reviewing and testing the code to ensure quality, and fixing any bugs to ensure smooth integration and deployment.
expected_outcome: If everything works correctly, the feature is implemented without errors, passes all tests, and integrates seamlessly with the existing system without causing any downtime or data inconsistency.

agents.description: Agent_1 is responsible for writing and implementing code based on the specified requirements.
Agent_2 reviews the code written by Agent_1, ensuring it meets quality standards and adheres to specifications.
Agent_3 tests the code for functionality, identifies and reports any bugs, and assists in fixing them.
